description: This file contains unit tests for CLI container target parsing and execution, including functions that handle container argument parsing, container resolution, and executing commands within containers, supporting both podman and docker runtimes.

methods.name: parseCliContainerArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract the '--container' flag and its value, returning whether parsing was successful, the container name if found, and the remaining argv.

methods.name: resolveCliContainerTarget
methods.description: Resolves the container target either from command-line arguments or environment variables.

methods.name: maybeRunCliInContainer
methods.description: Attempts to run the CLI command inside the specified container, handling runtime detection (podman/docker), container state, and environment considerations; skips or throws based on various conditions.
